<!-- Submitting a new sim case? Title your PR: "Case: <short title>" -->

## What kind of change is this?

- [ ] New sim case exemplar
- [ ] Edit to an existing case / module
- [ ] Curriculum module change
- [ ] Library / bibliography update
- [ ] Site code

## For new or edited cases

- [ ] Started from the standard case template
- [ ] All required frontmatter fields complete (see `src/content.config.ts`)
- [ ] `annotation` explains *why* the case teaches well, not just what it is
- [ ] `status` set appropriately (`draft` for new submissions)
- [ ] Self-checked against the rubric in `docs/sim-case-rubric.md`
- [ ] Any large files linked (R2 / library), not committed to the repo
- [ ] No copyrighted text re-hosted; texts link to licensed copies
